title: dep-scan doctor report
description: The document `depscan doctor --format json` prints and depscan.api.doctor().to_dict() returns. It names every tool a scan may call, where each was found, the vulnerability database as a read-only inspection sees it, and for every capability whether it can run on this machine and which missing requirement stops it. The report is produced without running a scan, prompting or downloading anything, and a missing tool or database is a reported state rather than an error.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this document shape. A later, incompatible report would carry 2 and leave this schema untouched.

depscanVersion.description: The version of the dep-scan installation that produced the report.

os.description: The operating system as Python's sys.platform reports it, for example linux, darwin or win32.

arch.description: The machine architecture, for example arm64 or x86_64.

libc.description: The C library, which decides the cdxgen plugin binary token on Linux (linux or linuxmusl). Null outside Linux.

tools.description: One entry per tool, in report order. A tool depscan does not use yet, edga for example, is still listed so the capabilities table can name it.

capabilities.description: Every capability dep-scan 7 defines, each with its own status. The list comes from one table in the code, which is the only place that knows which capability needs which tool or data.

name.description: The tool name the capability table refers to, for example cdxgen, golem, dotnet or cdxgen-plugins.

path.description: The path the tool was found at, or null when it was not found.

version.description: The version read with the tool's own version option, the plugins manifest, or the installed Python distribution. Null when it could not be read; a null version alone does not make a tool unusable.

source.description: Where the tool came from: path is a PATH lookup, env an environment variable naming it (sourceEnv says which), cdxgen-install the plugins package installed next to cdxgen, plugins-dir the CDXGEN_PLUGINS_DIR directory, bundled-sea the binary bundled with the standalone packages, bundled-runtime a runtime inside a self-contained dosai binary, library an installed Python package, runtime the interpreter this report runs in. Null when the tool is missing.

sourceEnv.description: The environment variable that named the tool, present only when source is env.

reason.description: Why the tool is missing or unusable, naming the remedy or the version needed. Null when the tool satisfies its requirements.

minVersion.description: The oldest version a scan expects. For cdxgen a version below it, or no readable version, makes the tool unusable and is explained in reason. For rusi it is a soft minimum: the scan warns and still runs an older rusi.

platform.description: The platform-arch tokens of a cdxgen plugin binary or the plugins directory, for example darwin-arm64 or linuxmusl-amd64.

present.description: Whether the database files exist. A missing database is a reported state; the doctor command never downloads or repairs one.

directory.description: The directory vdb keeps the database in.

image.description: The image reference recorded by the last download marker, or a shards marker. Null when no marker exists.

flavor.description: The flavor of the recorded image (full, app-only, app-extended, app-10y, app-10y-extended) or shards for a shard-set marker. Null when the marker is missing or names no known flavor.

enabled.description: Whether scans use the opt-in shard mode (VDB_USE_SHARDS).

name.description: The shard name in the local store.

ageDays.description: The age of the shard in days, or null when the store does not say.

present.description: The shards present in the local store, as vdb's own status lists them.

createdUtc.description: When the database was built, from vdb's metadata. Null when the metadata is missing or unreadable.

ageHours.description: The age of the database in hours. Null when the build time is unknown.

stale.description: Whether the database is past VDB_AGE_HOURS. Null when the age is unknown.

maxAgeHours.description: The VDB_AGE_HOURS window this installation uses.

cveDataCount.description: Rows in the cve_data tables at build time, from vdb's metadata. Null when unknown.

cveIndexCount.description: Rows in the cve_index tables at build time, from vdb's metadata. Null when unknown.

extendedMetadataPresent.description: Whether the extended search-metadata tables are populated (the *-extended flavors). Null when neither a row count nor the build metadata could answer.

cveMetadataRows.description: Rows in cve_metadata, counted through a read-only connection. Null when the database could not be opened or the table does not exist.

name.description: The capability name, a check name or a qualified name such as reachability:dotnet or memory-safety:c.

status.description: available means every requirement is satisfied on this machine. unavailable names the missing requirements in missing. not-implemented means this dep-scan version does not contain the analysis; the issue field links to where it is designed.

missing.description: The unsatisfied requirements, as tool:<name> or data:vdb. Empty unless the status is unavailable.

requirements.description: Everything the capability needs. Empty for a not-implemented capability, because requirements are not promised before the analysis exists.

issue.description: The dep-scan issue that designs or tracks the capability, for example https://github.com/owasp-dep-scan/dep-scan/issues/613.

description.description: One sentence saying what the capability does.
